Good morning. Here is your daily brief for Thursday 4 June 2026.

GBP/USD 1.345 · GBP/ILS 3.854.

🧬 Health, sleep & longevity
- Researchers have identified a significant gender gap in understanding how early or late puberty onset affects boys' long-term health outcomes, an area far less studied than girls' puberty timing despite its predictive value for future disease risk <https://www.statnews.com/2026/06/04/male-puberty-timing-long-term-health-risk-prediction/>
- Three scientific papers that were used by RFK Jr and allies to justify controversial vaccine policy changes are now facing new scrutiny and potential retraction investigations from scientists who question their findings and methodology <https://www.theguardian.com/science/2026/jun/04/vaccine-studies-rfk-jr>
- Weight-loss drugs have been shown in three studies to cut the risk of developing or dying from breast cancer by up to 30 percent, expanding the potential role of these medications beyond weight management into cancer prevention <https://www.theguardian.com/science/2026/jun/02/weight-loss-drugs-cut-cancer-risk-studies>
- So what for you: Given your eight-year Fitbit dataset tracking sleep and biomarkers, these findings on early intervention and biomarker prediction (puberty timing as health proxy, weight-loss drug effects on cancer risk) suggest your personal data could become increasingly valuable for monitoring long-term health trajectories in middle age.

🇬🇧 UK politics
- Reform UK received nine million pounds largely from crypto billionaires over three months, more than twice the donations of Labour and the Conservative Party combined, with seven million from two overseas British crypto billionaires earlier this year <https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/jun/04/reform-uk-raising-millions-more-than-other-parties-donation-figures-show>
- Prime Minister Keir Starmer accused Elon Musk of interfering in UK politics and attempting to whip up division over the Henry Nowak murder case, while backing MP Jess Asato's legal action against Grok for creating fake sexualised images of her <https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/jun/04/keir-starmer-elon-musk-division-henry-nowak>
- Conservative shadow work and pensions secretary Kemi Badenoch met with Henry Nowak's family this morning and praised their courage, while Starmer is scheduled to meet them this afternoon at Downing Street, with Nigel Farage making a rare PMQs appearance to question the police response <https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2026/jun/04/henry-nowak-death-policing-justice-farage-jenrick-reform-badenoch-burnham-latest-news-updates>
- So what for you: Reform's crypto billionaire funding surge signals a major shift in UK political financing that could reshape the landscape before the next election, affecting which parties can afford the kind of data and marketing infrastructure you'd recognise from SaaS scaling.

📱 Tech news
- Robotics startup Generalist, which released its GEN-1 model to complete short physical tasks in April, raised 400 million dollars in a funding round led by Radical Ventures at a 2 billion dollar valuation <https://www.techmeme.com/260604/p27#a260604p27>
- London and New York based Airspeed, which aims to use AI agents to replace sales software like traditional CRM dashboards, raised a 20 million dollar Series A led by DN Capital <https://www.techmeme.com/260604/p26#a260604p26>
- Amazon unveiled its next generation Proteus warehouse robot with AI powered language capabilities that let workers assign it tasks, rolling out in Europe in the first half of 2027 <https://www.techmeme.com/260604/p20#a260604p20>
- So what for you: Airspeed's approach to replacing CRM dashboards with AI agents directly parallels the sales tool modernisation you advise on, and the 20 million Series A signals that agentic sales software is becoming a serious alternative to traditional platforms like Monday.com.

📰 Hacker News top 3
- Bitcoin Has Longest Losing Streak Since August in Bruising Week <https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-06-04/bitcoin-btc-falls-to-pre-iran-conflict-low-as-crypto-slide-extends>
- VoidZero Is Joining Cloudflare <https://blog.cloudflare.com/voidzero-joins-cloudflare/>
- Ask HN: So what happened to Facebook "localhost" tracking? <https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48397731>

Today's question: If Airspeed's 20 million Series A validates agentic sales software as a real category, are you thinking about building or advising on a GTM play in that space, or does the margin compression scare you given what you've seen scale at Monday.com?
